en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al Hassan Bin Rabaat, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the gutter which happens to be higher than the well. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it was higher than the well, so there should be seven cubits (distance between the two); and when it was lower than the well, so five cubits from every direction, and that is sufficient’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Hassan ibn Ribat who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about a cesspool which is above a well. He (the Imam) said, ‘If it is above the well, the distance in between must be seven yards, but if it is below the well, the distance must be five yards from all sides, and that is a large area.”
